source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The touched pre-existing warning task asserts that BrowserTestUtils.isVisible(warning) is true, but its original message says the warning should be hidden. The fixed accepted task uses the visible caption for that assertion and resets the warning before the help-text task. This is a wrong expected-behavior message rather than a missing should word, and it was not introduced by the new help-text task. No browser test was executed.
title: The original select-warning caption says hidden while asserting visible
